query: UPDATE support_agent_jobs j SET lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes',attempts=attempts+1 FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.id=j.ticket_id AND j.ticket_id IN (SELECT ticket_id FROM support_agent_jobs WHERE due_at<=now() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<now()) AND attempts<5 ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 4 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING j.ticket_id,j.trigger_id,t.team_id
